name: Automatic Fire Suppression (3-4)
disable: DC 17 Thievery check (trained) to jam the sprinkler system or Engineering Lore (trained) on the control panel on the north wall to turn the system off.

items.name: Overloaded Extinguisher
items.text:
Trigger Fire damage is dealt in area A1

---

Effect Frozen fire retardant rains down on all creatures in area A1, dealing 2d10+7 cold damage (DC 20 basic Reflex save). Any persistent fire damage in area A1 ends.

text: Ceiling sprinklers spray in response to any fire in the room.
